message: Hi, my little one Elle is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have a Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class for ages 4-8 that's perfect for Elle. It's capped at 6 students per class so she'll get great attention. We offer a free trial class so she can try it out. Would you like to get that scheduled?
That sounds perfect! Yes, I’d like to schedule a trial class. What times do you have available?
Great! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Perfect, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
You can send the details to tester.saffron@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Last thing - can I get Elle's full name and date of birth? This helps us match her with the right class.
Sure! Her full name is Elle Saffron, and she was born on June 21, 2020.

Awesome! Elle is all set for the Kids 4-8 class.
Here are some available times this week:

Tuesday 7/7 at 4:30 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 4:30 PM
Tjursday 7/9 at 4:30 PM

Which works best for you?
*Thursday
Thursday 7/9 at 4:30 PM works best for us. Thank you!

Perfect! Elle is all booked for Thursday, July 9th at 4:30 PM for her free trial class. We'll send a confirmation to tester.saffron@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable clothes she can move in. See you Thursday!
